Pavel Kycek is a 20-year quant trader managing $20M+ AUM, using systematic strategies for institutions and high-net-worth clients.

In this episode, he breaks down the surprisingly simple strategies professionals actually use, the 4 core trading approaches behind most setups, where retail traders still have an edge, and why diversification and rebalancing may be the closest thing trading has to a “holy grail.”
